comment: Only the four chaos knobs have attenuverters; the six resonator CV jacks go straight in. The smooth knob has no jack at all. The forcing sine's frequency is the tone knob times the rate knob, so those two multiply into one figure. The bank gains and the level knob together set the total feedback gain, which is why turning them down can stop the module sounding altogether. configBypass passes the audio input to the audio output. The module ports Tom Mudd's Gutter Synthesis under GPL-3.0, also drawing on Kjeldgaard and Carver's SuperCollider port. The panel prints guttur, drive, tone, damp, rate, smooth, filters, bank a, bank b, pitch, q, spread, level, gain a, gain b, dist, reset, in, out and duff.
